from pathlib import Path
import re
p=Path('src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts')
s=Path('specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md')
tests={m.group(1):i for i,line in enumerate(p.read_text().splitlines(),1) if (m:=re.search(r\"it\\('(["'^'"']+)'\",line))}
text=s.read_text()

print(f'Reanchored {n} registry links')
